setupTasks.name: Install demo deps (all)
setupTasks.command: npm --prefix examples/codesandbox install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix examples/codesandbox-address install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix examples/codesandbox-express-checkout install --no-audit --no-fund

demo-card.name: Demo: card element (port 3000)
demo-card.command: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do npm --prefix examples/codesandbox install --no-audit --no-fund && break; sleep 5; done; npm --prefix examples/codesandbox start

demo-address.name: Demo: address element (port 3001)
demo-address.command: sleep 3; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do npm --prefix examples/codesandbox-address install --no-audit --no-fund && break; sleep 5; done; npm --prefix examples/codesandbox-address start

demo-express-checkout.name: Demo: express checkout (port 3002)
demo-express-checkout.command: sleep 6; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do npm --prefix examples/codesandbox-express-checkout install --no-audit --no-fund && break; sleep 5; done; npm --prefix examples/codesandbox-express-checkout start
